name: Substrate Consumption
authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This declares that UCOS CONSUMES the UAKP substrate and what it holds itself to as a consumer. It legislates nothing, owns no capability the substrate owns, and creates no rival to any located UCOS instrument.
$why_this_exists: UCOS Ω∞'s own constitution requires a universal platform that UCOS becomes a CONSUMER of,
and states the platform shall not be developed as part of UCOS. It was. The substrate is
now extracted and this is the binding back.
THE DIRECTION OF THE DEPENDENCY IS THE PROPERTY WORTH PROTECTING. UAKP contains no path,
register or declaration name belonging to UCOS, and a test in that repository refuses
their appearance. Everything UCOS-specific lives in engine/substrate/. An adapter placed
in the substrate would undo the extraction in one commit.
$not_a_runtime_dependency: pyproject.toml declares dependencies = [] on constitutional grounds (TP-04, TP-05); ISD-L-09 refuses a pinned runtime dependency; and test_infinite_scope.py asserts the list is empty. Consumption therefore happens in the GOVERNANCE plane, where declared tooling already lives. The runtime core remains stdlib-only and is untouched by this programme.
$fails_closed: The substrate has published no release and is installed from a local path. A gate that PASSED when its subject could not be imported would be the silent false green this apparatus exists to prevent, so an absent substrate is a FAULT — exit 2, no verdict — and never a pass.

$why_this_is_data: These eight names were a frozenset literal in engine/substrate/adapter.py. A set whose
membership can only change by editing a module is a closed enumeration, which
UCKP-ART-17 refuses — a future category is admitted by registration, never by
amendment. ISD-L-01 counted it and UCON-L-15 counted it, and both were right.
Admitting a name here is a data change: no engine change, no schema change, no
amendment. An empty or absent list is a FAULT rather than a default, because a default
would silently walk .git and .ec1-venv and report thousands of artifacts nothing
governs — a measurement that lies in the direction of alarm.

$authorities_comment: Four UCOS instruments are translated into substrate authorities, and each was added
because omitting it made the measurement lie:
artifacts.json  — the corpus register. Permit-gated and deliberately narrow.
exclusion-register.json — exclusion IS governance, not its absence. Omitting it reported
5,470 ungoverned artifacts, most of which UCOS had already argued for in writing.
id-ledger.json — UGA's object map, filtered to paths that still exist. An append-only
ledger records identity and does not claim presence: UCKP-ART-05 makes an identity
permanent, so a retired path keeps its entry forever. Treating history as a claim
reported thirteen 'claims over things that do not exist' — all genuinely absent, none
of them a defect, one of them the deliberate retirement of ledger_authority.py.
uec-declaration.json — the enforcement register, which binds every gate artifact to a
rule and to a named owner. Omitting it reported five artifacts as owned by nobody
while a UCOS instrument named all five, and two of them — uctx-gate.yml and
ufi-gate.yml — belong to other programmes entirely, so that error predated this one
and was found by it. Entries naming Make targets and verify.sh stages are governed
things that are not files; they are filtered out rather than allowed to absolve a path
that happens to share a name.
THE SAME MISTAKE FOUR TIMES: read one register and you have measured that register, not
the repository. Every fall in the ceiling below has come from reading one more — except
the largest, which came from finally reading one CORRECTLY. A register the consumer
cannot interpret is worse than one it does not consult, because the first looks consulted.

$contradictions: 0 artifacts that exist and that no UCOS authority claims.
IT MAY FALL AND MAY NEVER RISE. Every NEW ungoverned artifact fails the gate on the
commit that adds it, while the standing population is driven down. The ratchet is
two-sided: debt repaid without tightening the ceiling is refused exactly as new debt
is, which is why this number moves here rather than being left as slack.
WHY IT FELL FROM 320 TO 316. Adding the enforcement register as a fourth authority
absolved five artifacts UEC-000001 genuinely claims, and adding this programme's own
workflow added one, so the measurement moved 320 → 321 → 316. The four repaid are not
repayment in the sense of work done — they were never debt, and the previous number was
simply wrong. The ratchet refuses slack in exactly this situation, which is why the
ceiling comes down here rather than waiting for someone to notice the gap.
WHY IT THEN FELL FROM 316 TO 84, AND WHY 232 OF THOSE WERE NEVER DEBT. The consumer
applied the exclusion register's rules with fnmatch, which cannot express git's segment
grammar: it translates every * to .* and so cannot tell 00-MASTER/**/evidence/ from
00-MASTER/*/evidence/, and a trailing slash sent a rule down a literal-prefix branch that
matched neither. 221 artifacts were reported as governed by nobody while this register
named every one of them — 213 under 00-MASTER/**/evidence/, 6 under *.egg-info/, 2 under
**/.claude/. Three ordinary gitignore forms, each declared, each ignored by git, each
unreadable to the instrument obliged to apply it. The matcher is now git's grammar,
validated against git check-ignore --no-index rather than against inspection, and it
subtracts .gitignore's own !negations so a rule cannot absolve the twenty-four authored
files a carve-out exempts. The remaining 15 were genuinely undeclared: .uci-evidence/ (14
members) and coverage_gap_inventory.json now carry GENERATED_ENVIRONMENTAL entries with a
producer and a written reason, which is what this repository charges for an exclusion.
The arithmetic closes exactly: 320 measured, less 221 the register already named, less 15
newly declared, leaves 84.
WHY IT THEN FELL FROM 84 TO 0, AND WHAT THAT COST. The 84 were the anonymous
objects, and this declaration said of them that claiming one means minting a Universal
ID, that UCKP-ART-05 makes minting irreversible, and that this engine cannot repay them
and must not appear to. All three sentences were true and remain true: the debt was
discharged by an OPERATOR, through the only instrument that may discharge it — a permit
in 00-BOOK/DATA/allocation-permits.json, bound to a measured manifest digest, a pre-image
digest and a head, spent the moment the ledger moved. The gate did not repay this; it
measured it, said what it would cost, and named the authority that could pay. That is
the whole of what a fail-closed measurement is for.
The same number is counted independently by the UGA gate as UGA-INV-01 and UGA-INV-10;
instruments agreeing on one number is the evidence that the number is the repository's
and not this gate's. Debt that does not exist is not the safe direction to be wrong in:
a ceiling above the measurement is a licence for that many real regressions to arrive
unremarked, and raising it to hide one would be the single move this instrument exists
to refuse.

$why_no_verification_stage: TWO PLANES AND DELIBERATELY NOT THREE. UEC-L-06 requires two, so that deleting one
leaves a signal; the third plane every other capability gate has — a ./verify.sh
stage — is withheld, and the reason is the same one that makes FAULT the right verdict
verify.sh --full is what CI runs and what certifies a release. The substrate publishes
no release and is installed from a local path, so on a hosted runner this gate cannot
load its subject and correctly exits 2. A blocking stage would therefore make release
certification depend on an artifact no runner can fetch, and would report the absence
of a dependency as a failure of UCOS. The alternative — passing when the subject is
absent — is the false green this instrument exists to refuse, so neither direction is
available while the substrate is unpublished.
THE CONDITION IS WRITTEN DOWN RATHER THAN REMEMBERED. When uakp is installable from a
resolvable source, sub-gate.yml becomes `on: push` and a MAIN-phase stage is added to
verify.sh and to UVI-000001's stage registry. Until then the gap is declared here, and
`make substrate-gate` is the plane an operator runs.

exit_codes.2: FAULT — no verdict could be reached
